```{r}
# Folder with the saved Domain HTML pages (page_1.html, page_2.html, etc.)
pages_dir <- "dataset/domain"

# Pulls the page number out of filenames like "..._page_12.html"
extract_page_num <- function(x) {
  m <- str_match(basename(x), "page_(\\d+)\\.html$")
  as.integer(m[, 2])
}

# Simple helper: if 'a' is NULL, use 'b' instead
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
```

```{r}
# Break a full TAS address into street, suburb, state, and postcode
parse_address <- function(addr) {
  # Trim spaces; if empty, return blanks for all fields
  addr <- str_squish(addr %||% "")
  if (addr == "") return(tibble(street = NA, suburb = NA, state = NA, postcode = NA))

  # Handle format: "street, suburb TAS 7xxx"
  m1 <- str_match(addr, "^(.*?),\\s*(.*?)\\s+(TAS)\\s*(\\d{4})$")
  if (!any(is.na(m1))) {
    return(tibble(
      street   = str_squish(m1[,2]),
      suburb   = str_to_title(str_squish(m1[,3])),
      state    = "TAS",
      postcode = str_squish(m1[,5])
    ))
  }

  # Handle format: "street,suburbTAS7xxx" (no spaces)
  m2 <- str_match(addr, "^(.*?),(.*?)(TAS)(\\d{4})$")
  if (!any(is.na(m2))) {
    return(tibble(
      street   = str_squish(m2[,2]),
      suburb   = str_to_title(str_squish(m2[,3])),
      state    = "TAS",
      postcode = str_squish(m2[,5])
    ))
  }

  # If nothing matches, just return the raw text as street
  tibble(street = addr, suburb = NA, state = NA, postcode = NA)
}
```

```{r}
# Convert price text to numeric dollars where possible
parse_price_numeric <- function(price_text) {
  if (is.na(price_text) || str_trim(price_text) == "") return(NA_real_)

  # Normalise text: uppercase, remove commas and non-breaking spaces
  txt <- stringr::str_to_upper(price_text)
  txt <- stringr::str_replace_all(txt, "[,\\u00A0]", "")

  # Skip text-only placeholders
  if (stringr::str_detect(txt, "EOI|EXPRESSION|CONTACT|TENDER|AUCTION|BY NEGOTIATION|PRICE ON APPLICATION|POA|BY OFFER"))
    return(NA_real_)

  # Flexible match: find first number anywhere, with optional $ and optional K/M suffix
  m <- stringr::str_match(txt, ".*?\\$?\\s*([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)\\s*([KM])?.*")

  # Only the NUMBER capture is required; suffix may be NA
  if (is.na(m[,2])) return(NA_real_)

  val <- as.numeric(m[,2])
  suf <- m[,3]

  if (!is.na(suf)) {
    if (suf == "K") val <- val * 1e3
    if (suf == "M") val <- val * 1e6
  }

  as.numeric(round(val))
}
```

```{r}

# Normalise relative/absolute links to full Domain URLs
resolve_url <- function(href) {
  if (is.null(href) || is.na(href) || !nzchar(href)) return(NA_character_)
  href <- str_trim(href)
  if (str_detect(href, "^https?://")) return(href)
  if (!startsWith(href, "/")) href <- paste0("/", href)
  paste0("https://www.domain.com.au", href)
}

# Choose the most likely property link from a set of hrefs in a card
pick_property_href <- function(hrefs) {
  hrefs <- unique(hrefs[!is.na(hrefs) & nzchar(hrefs)])
  if (length(hrefs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  # Prioritise obvious listing links (sale/rent pages or property detail slugs/IDs)
  pri <- hrefs[str_detect(hrefs, "(^/|domain\\.com\\.au).*(/sale/|/rent/|/lease/|/property-|/\\d{6,})")]
  if (length(pri) > 0) return(pri[[1]])
  # Fallbacks
  rel <- hrefs[startsWith(hrefs, "/")]
  if (length(rel) > 0) return(rel[[1]])
  abs <- hrefs[str_detect(hrefs, "^https?://")]
  if (length(abs) > 0) return(abs[[1]])
  NA_character_
}

# Extract listing "cards" from a page (robust CSS; XPath fallback)
extract_cards <- function(page_doc) {
  sels <- c(
    "li[data-testid='search-results__listing'] article",     # common Domain pattern
    "[data-testid='search-results'] li article",
    "ul.css-163kh4h > li div.css-qrqvvg",                    # specific (may change)
    "ul li article",
    "ul li div"
  )
  for (s in sels) {
    cards <- html_elements(page_doc, s)
    if (length(cards) > 0) return(cards)
  }
  # Fallback: any <li> containing an <h2>
  html_elements(page_doc, xpath = "//li[.//h2]")
}

# Extract one row (Address_raw, Price_raw, Listing_URL) from a single card
extract_one <- function(card) {
  # ---- Address candidates (use length(el) to avoid xml_missing issues) ---
  addr_raw <- NA_character_
  for (el in list(
    card %>% html_element("h2"),
    card %>% html_element("[data-testid='listing-details__title'] h2"),
    card %>% html_element("[data-testid='listing-details__title']"),
    card %>% html_element("a h2"),
    card %>% html_element("a[title]")
  )) {
    if (length(el) > 0) {
      txt <- html_text2(el)
      if (!is.null(txt) && nzchar(str_squish(txt))) { addr_raw <- str_squish(txt); break }
    }
  }
    # ---- Price candidates --------------------------------------------------
  price_raw <- NA_character_
  for (el in list(
    card %>% html_element("p.css-mgq8yx"),
    card %>% html_element("[data-testid='listing-details__price']"),
    card %>% html_element("span[aria-label='price']")
  )) {
    if (length(el) > 0) {
      txt <- html_text2(el)
      if (!is.null(txt) && nzchar(str_squish(txt))) { price_raw <- str_squish(txt); break }
    }
  }
  if (is.na(price_raw)) {
    txts <- c(
      card %>% html_elements("p") %>% html_text2(),
      card %>% html_elements("span") %>% html_text2()
    )
    txts <- txts[!is.na(txts)]
    hits <- keep(txts, ~ str_detect(.x, "\\$|OFFER|EOI|EXPRESSION|CONTACT|AUCTION|TENDER"))
    if (length(hits) > 0) price_raw <- str_squish(hits[[1]])
  }

  # ---- URL candidates (robust, avoids xml_missing) ----------------------
  a_nodes <- html_elements(card, "a[href]")
  hrefs   <- if (length(a_nodes)) html_attr(a_nodes, "href") else character(0)
  picked  <- pick_property_href(hrefs)
  url_raw <- if (!is.na(picked)) resolve_url(picked) else NA_character_

  tibble(
    Address_raw = addr_raw %||% NA_character_,
    Price_raw   = price_raw %||% NA_character_,
    Listing_URL = url_raw   %||% NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}


# Scrape ONE saved HTML file into a tibble of rows
scrape_local_file <- function(filepath) {
  pg <- tryCatch(read_html(filepath), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(pg)) return(tibble())
  cards <- extract_cards(pg)
  if (length(cards) == 0) return(tibble())
  map_dfr(cards, extract_one) %>% distinct()
}

# --- Load all files, combine, filter TAS, parse, finalize ----------------
files <- list.files(pages_dir, pattern = "\\.html?$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(files) == 0) stop("No HTML files found in: ", pages_dir)

# If files are named with page numbers, sort them numerically (optional)
nums <- extract_page_num(files)
if (all(!is.na(nums))) files <- files[order(nums)]

raw_df <- map_dfr(files, scrape_local_file) %>% distinct()

if (nrow(raw_df) == 0) stop("Scrape returned 0 rows. Check that your saved HTML pages contain the listings.")

# We only want TAS (your search already is TAS-only; this double-checks)
tas_df <- raw_df %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(Address_raw, "\\bTAS\\b") |
      str_detect(Address_raw, "TAS\\s*\\d{4}") |
      str_detect(Address_raw, "TAS\\d{4}")
  )

if (nrow(tas_df) == 0) {
  message("No explicit 'TAS' detected in addresses; proceeding with all rows (since your search is TAS-only).")
  tas_df <- raw_df
}

addr_split <- map_dfr(tas_df$Address_raw, parse_address)

df <- bind_cols(tas_df, addr_split) %>%
  mutate(
    Price_numeric = map_dbl(Price_raw, parse_price_numeric),
    full_address  = str_squish(paste(street, suburb, state, postcode, "Australia"))
  )
```
